admission.justification: The renderer and shared grammar module must agree on a compact tab-derived look and complete whole-control recovery; copying styles or hiding excess controls would break that cross-file promise.

applicability: The shared dashboard role launcher and the grammar definition consumed by its controls and the view tabs.
conditions: The ordinary eleven-control task-needing one-feature composition fits one line at 1440px.
Extra controls or insufficient width wrap by whole controls without an overflow menu.
Selectors retain source spelling and an arrow; ModeBar retains its own phone-spacing overrides.
Launch offerings, ordering, disabled logic and payload behavior remain unchanged.
exclusions: An exact fixed pixel row height or an unconditional one-line requirement for excess features.
Changing embedded chat/navigation, launch permissions or saved defaults.
statement: The role launcher is one tight row in the look of the view tabs: ordinary eleven-control one-feature row one line at 1440px; excess controls wrap whole without clipping; view tabs and launcher controls share one definition; offered/sent behavior unchanged.
